explication: Speech Services is an Android text-to-speech engine for GrapheneOS. Android’s TTS interface submits text; the service chunks it, phonemizes it, encodes phoneme IDs, decodes audio, and streams PCM through the synthesis callback. The README also identifies on-device Matcha-TTS models and OpenNLP-based preprocessing. The graph includes those documented capabilities, but source excerpts do not show all resource-loading or preprocessing details, so uncertain connections are omitted.
